#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * capture-sdk.mjs: what @openai/codex-sdk 0.167.0 itself does, recorded by calling it directly (not through
 * Tarsee's engine) with the stub in place of the program. It covers what Tarsee's own turns never exercise but an
 * engineer replacing the SDK must still get right or deliberately leave out:
 *
 *   - how a `config` object becomes `--config key=value` arguments, for every kind of value
 *   - every option the SDK has (the ones Tarsee uses and the ones it does not), and the argument each produces
 *   - what the child's environment is when the caller passes `env` and when it does not
 *   - which program the SDK starts when no path is given, and what it then puts on PATH (run against a copy of the
 *     SDK's one file inside a made-up node_modules tree whose "pinned binary" is the stub)
 *   - how stdout lines become events, and what a bad line, a blank line, stderr and the exit code do
 *   - what an abort does
 *
 *   node capture-sdk.mjs [scenario ...]
 */
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const PROJECT = process.env.CAPTURE_PROJECT || "/path/to/the/node/checkout";
const SCRATCH = process.env.CAPTURE_SCRATCH || "/path/to/a/scratch/folder";
const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT || path.join(SCRATCH, "fixtures-sdk");
const STUB_DIR = path.join(SCRATCH, "stub");
const EXE = process.platform === "win32" ? ".exe" : "";
const STUB = path.join(STUB_DIR, `codex-stub${EXE}`);
const RUNS = path.join(SCRATCH, "runs-sdk");
const TMP = path.join(SCRATCH, "tmp");
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

// This process's own environment, cut down to a known one: the SDK copies it when the caller passes no `env`.
const KEEP = process.platform === "win32" ? ["SYSTEMROOT", "SYSTEMDRIVE", "COMSPEC"] : [];
for (const k of Object.keys(process.env)) if (!KEEP.includes(k.toUpperCase())) delete process.env[k];
process.env.PATH = process.platform === "win32" ? "C:\\WINDOWS\\system32;C:\\WINDOWS" : "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin";
process.env.TEMP = TMP;
process.env.TMP = TMP;
process.env.TMPDIR = TMP;
process.env.FROM_PROCESS_ENV = "the caller's own environment";

const SDK_FILE = path.join(PROJECT, "node_modules/@openai/codex-sdk/dist/index.js");
const { Codex } = await import(pathToFileURL(SDK_FILE).href);

const fake = (...parts) => parts.join("");
const API_KEY = fake("sk-", "test-not-a-key-", "sdk");
const THREAD = "01a1c000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000bb";
const PNG = Buffer.from("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==", "base64");

const okEvents = (threadId = THREAD) => [
  { type: "thread.started", thread_id: threadId },
  { type: "turn.started" },
  { type: "item.completed", item: { id: "item_0", type: "agent_message", text: "ok" } },
  { type: "turn.completed", usage: { input_tokens: 10, cached_input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 2, reasoning_output_tokens: 0 } },
];
const lines = (events) => events.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join("\n") + "\n";

function writePlan(planDir, { record, stdout, exit, stderr, sleepMs, alive }) {
  fs.rmSync(planDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(planDir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "record.txt"), record);
  if (stdout != null) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "stdout.jsonl"), stdout);
  if (exit != null) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "exit.txt"), String(exit));
  if (stderr) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "stderr.txt"), stderr);
  if (sleepMs) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "sleep_ms.txt"), String(sleepMs));
  if (alive) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(planDir, "alive.txt"), alive);
}

function forms(value) {
  const out = new Set([value, value.split("\\").join("/")]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (const f of [...out]) out.add(JSON.stringify(f).slice(1, -1));
  return [...out];
}
function scrub(text, pairs) {
  const all = [];
  for (const [value, label] of pairs) if (value) for (const f of forms(String(value))) all.push([f, label]);
  all.sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length);
  let out = text;
  for (const [f, label] of all) out = out.split(f).join(label);
  return out;
}

const errorShape = (err) => (err ? {
  name: err.name, message: err.message, code: err.code ?? null,
  cause: err.cause ? { name: err.cause.name, message: err.cause.message } : null,
} : null);

/**
 * One run of the SDK. s: { codexOptions, method, threadId, threadOptions, input, turnOptions, plan (stdout, exit,
 * stderr, sleepMs), abortAfterMs, sdk (a Codex class other than the real one's), stub (the program path), planDir }.
 */
async function runSdk(name, s) {
  const root = path.join(RUNS, name);
  fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  const ws = path.join(root, "workspace");
  const extra = path.join(root, "extra-dir");
  fs.mkdirSync(ws, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(extra, { recursive: true });
  const image = path.join(root, "picture.png");
  fs.writeFileSync(image, PNG);
  const recordFile = path.join(root, "stub-record.json");
  const aliveFile = path.join(root, "alive.txt");
  const planDir = s.planDir || path.join(STUB_DIR, "plan");
  writePlan(planDir, { record: recordFile, stdout: lines(okEvents(s.threadId || THREAD)), alive: s.abortAfterMs != null || s.watchAlive || s.killExternallyAfterEvents ? aliveFile : null, ...(s.plan || {}) });

  const subst = (v) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v ?? null).split("<WS>").join(JSON.stringify(ws).slice(1, -1)).split("<EXTRA>").join(JSON.stringify(extra).slice(1, -1)).split("<IMAGE>").join(JSON.stringify(image).slice(1, -1)));
  const codexOptions = { ...(subst(s.codexOptions) || {}), ...(s.useStub === false ? {} : { codexPathOverride: s.stub || STUB }) };
  const threadOptions = s.threadOptions === undefined ? undefined : subst(s.threadOptions);
  const input = subst(s.input ?? "hello");
  const ac = s.abortAfterMs != null || s.abortBeforeStart ? new AbortController() : null;
  if (s.abortBeforeStart) ac.abort();
  const turnOptions = { ...(s.turnOptions || {}), ...(ac ? { signal: ac.signal } : {}) };

  const CodexClass = s.sdk || Codex;
  const codex = new CodexClass(codexOptions);
  const thread = s.threadId ? codex.resumeThread(s.threadId, threadOptions) : codex.startThread(threadOptions);
  const yielded = [];
  let thrown = null;
  let abortedAt = null;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  let endedAt = null;
  let schemaSeen = null;
  let aliveAtAbort = null;
  try {
    const { events } = await thread.runStreamed(input, turnOptions);
    for await (const ev of events) {
      yielded.push(ev);
      // Abort a fixed time after the last scripted event has arrived (so a slow process start cannot beat it).
      if (s.killExternallyAfterEvents && yielded.length === s.killExternallyAfterEvents) {
        // End the program from outside (not through the SDK), the way a crash or an operator's kill would.
        const pid = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(recordFile, "utf8")).pid;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (process.platform === "win32") spawnSync(path.join(process.env.SYSTEMROOT || "C:\\WINDOWS", "System32", "taskkill.exe"), ["/PID", String(pid), "/F"], { stdio: "ignore" });
          else process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
        }, 200);
      }
      if (ac && yielded.length === s.abortAfterEvents) setTimeout(() => { abortedAt = Date.now() - t0; try { aliveAtAbort = Number(fs.readFileSync(aliveFile, "utf8")); } catch { /* none */ } ac.abort(); }, s.abortAfterMs);
      if (schemaSeen === null && turnOptions.outputSchema !== undefined) {
        // While the turn runs, the schema file the SDK wrote is still there.
        try {
          const rec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(recordFile, "utf8"));
          const file = rec.argv[rec.argv.indexOf("--output-schema") + 1];
          schemaSeen = { path: file, content: fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8") };
        } catch { /* the stub has not written its record yet */ }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    thrown = err;
  }
  endedAt = Date.now() - t0;

  let rec = null;
  try { rec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(recordFile, "utf8")); } catch { /* never started */ }
  let lastAlive = null;
  if (ac || s.watchAlive) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
    try { lastAlive = Number(fs.readFileSync(aliveFile, "utf8")); } catch { /* none */ }
    const again = await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { try { r(Number(fs.readFileSync(aliveFile, "utf8"))); } catch { r(null); } }, 300));
    if (again !== lastAlive) lastAlive = `still running (${lastAlive} then ${again})`;
  }
  const trim = (t) => (s.trimStdinText && t.length > 200 ? `${t.slice(0, 60)} … (${t.length} characters in all) … ${t.slice(-40)}` : t);
  const passedEnv = codexOptions.env || null;
  const fixture = {
    name,
    what: s.why,
    made_with: { sdk: "@openai/codex-sdk 0.167.0, called directly", platform: process.platform },
    sdk: {
      "new Codex(options)": codexOptions,
      thread: s.threadId ? { method: "resumeThread", threadId: s.threadId, threadOptions } : { method: "startThread", threadOptions },
      "runStreamed(input, turnOptions)": { input: typeof input === "string" ? trim(input) : input, inputLength: typeof input === "string" ? { characters: input.length, utf8Bytes: Buffer.byteLength(input, "utf8") } : undefined, turnOptions: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(turnOptions).map(([k, v]) => [k, k === "signal" ? "<AbortSignal>" : v])) },
      callerProcessEnvNames: Object.keys(process.env).sort(),
    },
    child: rec ? {
      program: s.stub || STUB,
      argv: rec.argv,
      cwd: rec.cwd,
      envNames: Object.keys(rec.env).sort(),
      envValues: Object.fromEntries(["CODEX_API_KEY", "CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE", "FROM_PROCESS_ENV", "FROM_ENV_OPTION", "PATH", "Path", "path"].filter((n) => n in rec.env).map((n) => [n, rec.env[n]])),
      envNamesNotInEnvOption: passedEnv ? Object.keys(rec.env).filter((n) => !Object.keys(passedEnv).some((p) => p.toUpperCase() === n.toUpperCase())).sort() : undefined,
      stdin: { text: trim(rec.stdin.text), sameAsTheInput: typeof input === "string" ? rec.stdin.text === input : undefined, bytes: rec.stdin.bytes, chunks: rec.stdin.chunks.map((c) => ({ at_ms: c.at_ms, bytes: c.bytes })), eof_at_ms: rec.stdin.eof_at_ms },
    } : null,
    outputSchemaFile: schemaSeen ? { ...schemaSeen, existsAfterTheTurn: fs.existsSync(schemaSeen.path) } : undefined,
    stub: { stdout: (s.plan?.stdout ?? lines(okEvents(s.threadId || THREAD))), stderr: s.plan?.stderr ?? "", exitCode: s.plan?.exit ?? 0, sleepMsBeforeExit: s.plan?.sleepMs ?? 0 },
    sdkYielded: yielded,
    sdkThrew: errorShape(thrown),
    programAfterTheError: s.watchAlive ? { note: "the stub would have run for sleepMsBeforeExit more; its heartbeat (ms since it started, every 20 ms) stopped at", stubLastAliveMs: lastAlive } : undefined,
    abort: ac ? {
      note: "abortedAtMs and iterationEndedAtMs are since runStreamed() was called; the stub's two values are on its own clock (ms since it started), written every 20 ms",
      abortedAtMs: abortedAt, iterationEndedAtMs: endedAt, stubAliveWhenAbortFiredMs: aliveAtAbort, stubLastAliveMs: lastAlive,
    } : undefined,
  };
  const pairs = [
    [ws, "<WORKSPACE>"], [extra, "<EXTRA_DIR>"], [image, "<IMAGE_FILE>"], [s.scrubRoot ? null : (s.stub || STUB), "<CODEX_BIN>"], [TMP, "<TMP>"], [s.scrubRoot, "<NODE_MODULES>"],
    [path.resolve(PROJECT), "<TARSEE_ROOT>"], [process.cwd(), "<CALLER_CWD>"], [os.homedir(), "<HOME>"], [API_KEY, "<API_KEY>"], [SCRATCH, "<SCRATCH>"],
  ];
  let text = scrub(JSON.stringify(fixture, null, 2), pairs);
  text = text.replace(/codex-output-schema-[A-Za-z0-9]{6}/g, "codex-output-schema-<RANDOM>");
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.json`), text + "\n");
  console.log(`${name}: ${rec ? `${rec.argv.length} arguments` : "not started"}; yielded ${yielded.length}; ${thrown ? `threw ${thrown.name}: ${String(thrown.message).split("\n")[0].slice(0, 100)}` : "no error"}`);
  return fixture;
}

// --- A copy of the SDK's one file in a made-up node_modules tree, so "the pinned binary" is the stub ------------------

function sha256(file) { return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest("hex"); }

/** layout: "package" (vendor/<triple>/bin + codex-package.json + codex-path) or "legacy" (vendor/<triple>/codex + path). */
async function pinnedTree(layout) {
  const TRIPLES = {
    "win32-x64": ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "codex-win32-x64"], "win32-arm64": ["aarch64-pc-windows-msvc", "codex-win32-arm64"],
    "linux-x64": ["x86_64-unknown-linux-musl", "codex-linux-x64"], "linux-arm64": ["aarch64-unknown-linux-musl", "codex-linux-arm64"],
    "darwin-x64": ["x86_64-apple-darwin", "codex-darwin-x64"], "darwin-arm64": ["aarch64-apple-darwin", "codex-darwin-arm64"],
  };
  const [triple, pkg] = TRIPLES[`${process.platform}-${process.arch}`];
  const root = path.join(SCRATCH, `pinned-${layout}`, "node_modules");
  fs.rmSync(path.dirname(root), { recursive: true, force: true });
  const sdkDir = path.join(root, "@openai", "codex-sdk");
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(sdkDir, "dist"), { recursive: true });
  fs.copyFileSync(SDK_FILE, path.join(sdkDir, "dist", "index.js"));
  fs.copyFileSync(path.join(PROJECT, "node_modules/@openai/codex-sdk/package.json"), path.join(sdkDir, "package.json"));
  if (sha256(path.join(sdkDir, "dist", "index.js")) !== sha256(SDK_FILE)) throw new Error("the SDK copy differs");
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, "@openai", "codex"), { recursive: true });
  fs.copyFileSync(path.join(PROJECT, "node_modules/@openai/codex/package.json"), path.join(root, "@openai", "codex", "package.json"));
  const platformDir = path.join(root, "@openai", pkg);
  const vendor = path.join(platformDir, "vendor", triple);
  fs.mkdirSync(vendor, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(platformDir, "package.json"), JSON.stringify({ name: "@openai/codex", version: "0.167.0-capture" }));
  let binDir;
  let pathDir;
  if (layout === "package") {
    binDir = path.join(vendor, "bin");
    pathDir = path.join(vendor, "codex-path");
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(vendor, "codex-package.json"), JSON.stringify({ layoutVersion: 1, version: "0.167.0", target: triple, variant: "codex", entrypoint: `bin/codex${EXE}`, resourcesDir: "codex-resources", pathDir: "codex-path" }));
  } else {
    binDir = path.join(vendor, "codex");
    pathDir = path.join(vendor, "path");
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(binDir, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(pathDir, { recursive: true });
  const stub = path.join(binDir, `codex${EXE}`);
  fs.copyFileSync(STUB, stub);
  const sdk = (await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(sdkDir, "dist", "index.js")).href)).Codex;
  return { sdk, stub, planDir: path.join(binDir, "plan"), root, pathDir };
}

// --- Scenarios -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const SCENARIOS = {
  "sdk-01-config-flattening": async () => runSdk("sdk-01-config-flattening", {
    why: "How `config` becomes --config arguments: every kind of value the SDK accepts. A table is flattened into dotted keys, one argument per leaf; anything inside an array is written as one TOML value (tables there become inline tables).",
    codexOptions: {
      env: { FROM_ENV_OPTION: "the env option" },
      config: {
        string_plain: "hello",
        string_quotes_backslash: "say \"hi\" to C:\\Users\\me",
        string_newline_tab: "line one\nline two\ttabbed",
        string_unicode: "caf\u00e9 \u2603 \ud83d\ude00",
        string_control: "bell\u0007 esc\u001b del\u007f",
        string_empty: "",
        integer: 42,
        negative: -7,
        float: 0.85,
        exponent_large: 1e21,
        exponent_small: 1e-7,
        bool_true: true,
        bool_false: false,
        array_empty: [],
        array_strings: ["a", "b c", "d\"e"],
        array_numbers: [1, 2.5, -3],
        array_mixed_nested: [1, "two", [3, 4], true],
        array_of_tables: [{ name: "first", n: 1 }, { "key with space": "v", nested: { deep: true } }],
        table_empty: {},
        table: { leaf: "v", inner: { leaf2: 2, list: ["x"], empty: {} } },
        skipped_undefined: undefined,
        "key with space": "top-level key is not quoted",
        "dotted.key": "a dot in a key reads as a deeper path",
        table_awkward_keys: { "X-Header-Name": "bare", "has space": 1, "has.dot": 2, "quote\"d": 3 },
      },
    },
  }),

  "sdk-02-every-option": async () => runSdk("sdk-02-every-option", {
    why: "Every option the SDK has at once, on a new thread, in the order the SDK emits them: config, configOverrides (raw), baseUrl, model, threadSource, sandboxMode, workingDirectory, additionalDirectories, skipGitRepoCheck, outputSchema, cyberAccessProgram, modelReasoningEffort, networkAccessEnabled, webSearchMode, approvalPolicy, images; apiKey as CODEX_API_KEY. The input is two text parts and a picture.",
    codexOptions: {
      env: { FROM_ENV_OPTION: "the env option", CODEX_API_KEY: "overwritten by apiKey" },
      apiKey: API_KEY,
      baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1",
      config: { a: { b: 1 } },
      configOverrides: ["raw.override=\"passed unchanged\"", "another=1"],
    },
    threadOptions: {
      model: "some-model", threadSource: "capture", sandboxMode: "workspace-write", workingDirectory: "<WS>", additionalDirectories: ["<EXTRA>", "<WS>"],
      skipGitRepoCheck: true, modelReasoningEffort: "minimal", networkAccessEnabled: false, webSearchMode: "cached", webSearchEnabled: true, approvalPolicy: "on-request",
    },
    input: [{ type: "text", text: "first part" }, { type: "local_image", path: "<IMAGE>" }, { type: "text", text: "second part" }],
    turnOptions: { outputSchema: { type: "object", properties: { answer: { type: "string" } }, required: ["answer"], additionalProperties: false }, cyberAccessProgram: "standard" },
  }),

  "sdk-03-every-option-resumed": async () => runSdk("sdk-03-every-option-resumed", {
    why: "The same on a resumed thread: threadSource is left out, `resume <id>` comes after every option and before --image.",
    threadId: THREAD,
    codexOptions: { env: { FROM_ENV_OPTION: "the env option" }, apiKey: API_KEY, baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1", config: { a: { b: 1 } }, configOverrides: ["raw.override=\"passed unchanged\""] },
    threadOptions: {
      model: "some-model", threadSource: "capture", sandboxMode: "read-only", workingDirectory: "<WS>", additionalDirectories: ["<EXTRA>"],
      skipGitRepoCheck: true, modelReasoningEffort: "max", networkAccessEnabled: true, webSearchEnabled: true, approvalPolicy: "untrusted",
    },
    input: [{ type: "text", text: "again" }, { type: "local_image", path: "<IMAGE>" }, { type: "local_image", path: "<IMAGE>" }],
    turnOptions: { outputSchema: { type: "object" } },
  }),

  "sdk-04-no-options": async () => runSdk("sdk-04-no-options", {
    why: "Nothing but the program's path: no env option (so the child gets a copy of the caller's whole process environment), no config, no thread options. The shortest command line the SDK produces.",
    codexOptions: {},
    input: "",
  }),

  "sdk-05-web-search-false-no-skip": async () => runSdk("sdk-05-web-search-false-no-skip", {
    why: "webSearchEnabled false with no webSearchMode gives web_search=\"disabled\"; skipGitRepoCheck false and networkAccessEnabled undefined give nothing; an empty additionalDirectories gives nothing; an empty env option ({}) counts as given.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    threadOptions: { webSearchEnabled: false, skipGitRepoCheck: false, additionalDirectories: [], sandboxMode: "danger-full-access" },
    input: [{ type: "text", text: "only text" }],
  }),

  "sdk-06-pinned-binary-package-layout": async () => {
    const t = await pinnedTree("package");
    return runSdk("sdk-06-pinned-binary-package-layout", {
      why: "No codexPathOverride: the SDK resolves @openai/codex, then its platform package, and starts vendor/<triple>/bin/codex(.exe) (the layout 0.167.0 ships, marked by codex-package.json), with vendor/<triple>/codex-path put first on the child's PATH. Run against a byte-for-byte copy of the SDK's file inside a made-up node_modules whose binary is the stub. The env option here carries both `Path` and `PATH`.",
      sdk: t.sdk, stub: t.stub, planDir: t.planDir, useStub: false, scrubRoot: t.root,
      codexOptions: { env: { FROM_ENV_OPTION: "the env option", PATH: "C:\\one;C:\\two", Path: "C:\\three;C:\\four", SystemRoot: "C:\\WINDOWS" } },
    });
  },

  "sdk-07-pinned-binary-legacy-layout": async () => {
    const t = await pinnedTree("legacy");
    return runSdk("sdk-07-pinned-binary-legacy-layout", {
      why: "The older layout the SDK still accepts: vendor/<triple>/codex/codex(.exe), with vendor/<triple>/path put first on PATH. No env option, so PATH is the caller's own with that folder in front.",
      sdk: t.sdk, stub: t.stub, planDir: t.planDir, useStub: false, scrubRoot: t.root,
      codexOptions: {},
    });
  },

  "sdk-19-windows-env-fill-in": async () => {
    // Give this process a full Windows-like environment (made-up values, so none of this machine's are recorded) and
    // pass an `env` with one name in it: which of the caller's names turn up in the child anyway?
    const made = {
      HOMEDRIVE: "C:", HOMEPATH: "\\Users\\capture", LOGONSERVER: "\\\\CAPTURE", USERDOMAIN: "CAPTURE", USERNAME: "capture", USERPROFILE: "C:\\Users\\capture",
      WINDIR: "C:\\WINDOWS", APPDATA: "C:\\Users\\capture\\AppData\\Roaming", LOCALAPPDATA: "C:\\Users\\capture\\AppData\\Local", PROGRAMFILES: "C:\\Program Files",
      PROGRAMDATA: "C:\\ProgramData", PATHEXT: ".COM;.EXE;.BAT;.CMD", COMPUTERNAME: "CAPTURE", OS: "Windows_NT", NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS: "8", PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE: "AMD64",
      PUBLIC: "C:\\Users\\Public", ALLUSERSPROFILE: "C:\\ProgramData", COMMONPROGRAMFILES: "C:\\Program Files\\Common Files",
    };
    const before = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(made)) { before[k] = process.env[k]; process.env[k] = v; }
    try {
      return await runSdk("sdk-19-windows-env-fill-in", {
        why: "Windows only, and Node's doing, not the SDK's: when `env` is given, Node still copies a fixed set of system names from the caller's own environment into the child if `env` lacks them. The caller here has a full made-up Windows environment (callerProcessEnvNames) and passes env = {FROM_ENV_OPTION}: child.envNamesNotInEnvOption lists what arrived anyway.",
        codexOptions: { env: { FROM_ENV_OPTION: "the env option" } },
      });
    } finally {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(before)) { if (v === undefined) delete process.env[k]; else process.env[k] = v; }
    }
  },

  "sdk-20-long-unicode-prompt": async () => runSdk("sdk-20-long-unicode-prompt", {
    why: "A prompt of 300,000 characters with non-ASCII in it: written to stdin as UTF-8 in one write() and then closed; the program reads it in pieces (the pipe's), and its end is the end of stdin. Nothing is added: no newline, no length, no framing.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    input: `h\u00e9llo \u2603 \ud83d\ude00\n${"0123456789".repeat(30000)}\nlast line with no newline after it`,
    trimStdinText: true,
  }),

  "sdk-08-stdout-not-json": async () => runSdk("sdk-08-stdout-not-json", {
    why: "A stdout line that is not JSON: the events before it are yielded, then the SDK throws `Failed to parse item: <line>` and stops reading.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: { stdout: `${JSON.stringify({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD })}\nthis is not json\n${JSON.stringify({ type: "turn.started" })}\n` },
  }),

  "sdk-09-stdout-blank-line": async () => runSdk("sdk-09-stdout-blank-line", {
    why: "An empty stdout line is a line like any other: it is not JSON, so the SDK throws on it.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: { stdout: `${JSON.stringify({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD })}\n\n${JSON.stringify({ type: "turn.started" })}\n` },
  }),

  "sdk-10-stdout-crlf-no-final-newline-unknown": async () => runSdk("sdk-10-stdout-crlf-no-final-newline-unknown", {
    why: "CRLF line ends, a last line with no line end, an event type the SDK does not know and extra fields: all pass through as parsed. turn.completed without cache_write_input_tokens gets it as 0; one that has it keeps its value.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: {
      stdout: [
        JSON.stringify({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD, extra_field: 1 }),
        JSON.stringify({ type: "some.future.event", payload: { x: 1 } }),
        JSON.stringify({ type: "turn.completed", usage: { input_tokens: 5, cached_input_tokens: 1, output_tokens: 2, reasoning_output_tokens: 0 } }),
        JSON.stringify({ type: "turn.completed", usage: { input_tokens: 5, cached_input_tokens: 1, cache_write_input_tokens: 3, output_tokens: 2, reasoning_output_tokens: 0 } }),
      ].join("\r\n"),
    },
  }),

  "sdk-11-exit-nonzero-after-events": async () => runSdk("sdk-11-exit-nonzero-after-events", {
    why: "Exit code 1 with text on stderr after a failed turn (what codex does): every event is yielded first, then the SDK throws `Codex Exec exited with code 1: <all of stderr>`.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: {
      stdout: lines([{ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD }, { type: "turn.started" }, { type: "error", message: "boom" }, { type: "turn.failed", error: { message: "boom" } }]),
      stderr: "Reading prompt from stdin...\nERROR something went wrong\n", exit: 1,
    },
  }),

  "sdk-12-exit-nonzero-no-output": async () => runSdk("sdk-12-exit-nonzero-no-output", {
    why: "Exit code 2 with nothing on stdout (a refused argument): nothing is yielded, the SDK throws with the exit code and stderr.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: { stdout: "", stderr: "error: unexpected argument '--bogus' found\n\nUsage: codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]\n", exit: 2 },
  }),

  "sdk-13-exit-zero-with-stderr": async () => runSdk("sdk-13-exit-zero-with-stderr", {
    why: "Exit code 0 with text on stderr: stderr is collected and dropped, nothing is thrown.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: { stderr: "Reading prompt from stdin...\nWARNING: something harmless\n", exit: 0 },
  }),

  "sdk-14-exit-zero-no-output": async () => runSdk("sdk-14-exit-zero-no-output", {
    why: "Exit code 0 with nothing on stdout: nothing is yielded and nothing is thrown (the caller sees an empty stream).",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    plan: { stdout: "", exit: 0 },
  }),

  "sdk-15-abort-while-running": async () => runSdk("sdk-15-abort-while-running", {
    why: "The caller's AbortSignal fires 300 ms after the second event of a turn that is still running (the stub wrote two events and sleeps 30 s). When the stub stopped, what the SDK threw, and how long the iteration took to end.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} },
    abortAfterMs: 300, abortAfterEvents: 2,
    plan: { stdout: lines([{ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD }, { type: "turn.started" }]), sleepMs: 30000 },
  }),

  "sdk-17-bad-line-ends-the-program": async () => runSdk("sdk-17-bad-line-ends-the-program", {
    why: "After a stdout line that is not JSON the SDK does not leave the program running: the stub would have slept 20 s, and its heartbeat stops right after the bad line.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} }, watchAlive: true,
    plan: { stdout: `${JSON.stringify({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD })}
this is not json
`, sleepMs: 20000 },
  }),

  "sdk-18-program-killed-from-outside": async () => runSdk("sdk-18-program-killed-from-outside", {
    why: "The program is ended from outside mid-turn (taskkill /F on Windows, SIGKILL elsewhere), not by the SDK: what the SDK throws.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} }, killExternallyAfterEvents: 2,
    plan: { stdout: lines([{ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD }, { type: "turn.started" }]), sleepMs: 20000 },
  }),

  "sdk-21-signal-already-aborted": async () => runSdk("sdk-21-signal-already-aborted", {
    why: "The caller's AbortSignal has already fired when runStreamed() is called: whether the program is started at all, and what the SDK throws.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} }, abortBeforeStart: true, watchAlive: true,
    plan: { stdout: lines([{ type: "thread.started", thread_id: THREAD }, { type: "turn.started" }]), sleepMs: 5000 },
  }),

  "sdk-16-program-missing": async () => runSdk("sdk-16-program-missing", {
    why: "codexPathOverride names a file that is not there: what the SDK throws.",
    codexOptions: { env: {} }, stub: path.join(SCRATCH, "no-such-folder", `codex${EXE}`),
  }),
};

const only = process.argv.slice(2);
for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries(SCENARIOS)) {
  if (only.length && !only.some((o) => name.includes(o))) continue;
  try { await fn(); } catch (err) { console.log(`${name}: CAPTURE FAILED: ${err?.stack || err}`); }
}
process.exit(0);
